movement_profile.formation_and_space: Group routines performed on arena floors by squads ranging from 5 to 38 athletes in defined division categories.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Routines incorporate tiered difficulty levels from Level 1 to Level 6, including high kick and performance dance categories.
movement_profile.partnering: Team configurations categorized into all-girl (female only) or co-ed (mixed gender) stunt and dance groups.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Exceeding crossover limits (no more than 2 cheer teams and 6 total routines per event), violating age spread limits (senior teams cannot exceed a 10-year age gap), or entering younger athletes into restricted high difficulty levels.

music_profile.musical_form: Routines structured to mandatory division time limits.

teaching.formation: Squads arrayed in divisions from X-Small (5-14 athletes) up to Large (33-38 athletes), configured as all-girl or co-ed teams on a competition floor.
teaching.level_notes: Levels range from Level 1 up to Level 6, alongside Novice, All Star Prep, and All Star Elite divisions regulated by age grids and IASF safety guidelines.
